_comment: ElevenLabs 효과음 주문서. 이름은 scripts/ui/sfx.gd의 소리 이름과 같다. .github/workflows/make-sfx.yml이 이 파일을 읽어 만든다. seconds는 0.5~30.

sounds.name: click
sounds.text: Soft bubbly UI button tap, short cute pop, casual mobile game

sounds.name: step
sounds.text: One loud clear wooden game piece tap on a board, single tok, close microphone

sounds.name: dice
sounds.text: Two dice shaken and rolled on a wooden table, rattling then settling

sounds.name: hit
sounds.text: Cartoon sword hit, short punchy slash impact, game combat

sounds.name: win
sounds.text: Short bright victory jingle, cheerful brass and bells, casual mobile game

sounds.name: lose
sounds.text: Short sad descending jingle, gentle, casual mobile game fail

sounds.name: good
sounds.text: Positive chime, two rising marimba notes, reward pickup

sounds.name: bad
sounds.text: Negative low buzz, two falling notes, soft error, casual game

sounds.name: reveal
sounds.text: Magical reveal swell, rising shimmer, card flip reveal

sounds.name: whoosh
sounds.text: Fast airy whoosh swipe, UI banner sliding in

sounds.name: impact
sounds.text: Heavy cinematic drum impact, deep boom with short tail

sounds.name: sparkle
sounds.text: Glittering sparkle twinkle, high bells, magical dust

sounds.name: card
sounds.text: Playing card dealt, quick paper flick

sounds.name: skill
sounds.text: Hero special ability activation, energy charge up then burst, anime game

sounds.name: fanfare
sounds.text: Triumphant short fanfare, brass and drums, game match victory

sounds.name: defeat
sounds.text: Somber short defeat sting, low strings descending, game over

sounds.name: fling
sounds.text: Cartoon character knocked back flying away, descending whistle

sounds.name: land
sounds.text: One loud clear soft thump of a game piece landing, close microphone

sounds.name: coin
sounds.text: Coins collected, bright metallic clink, game reward

sounds.name: tile_treasure
sounds.text: Treasure chest opening with sparkling coins, short happy game reward

sounds.name: tile_prison
sounds.text: Heavy iron jail door slamming shut with a metallic clang, short

sounds.name: tile_curse
sounds.text: Dark magic curse cast, eerie low whoosh with a sinister shimmer, short

sounds.name: tile_luck
sounds.text: Lucky charm chime, bright magical bells rising, short and cheerful

sounds.name: tile_forward
sounds.text: Fast upward dash boost, cartoon speed swoosh with a spring

sounds.name: tile_trap
sounds.text: Trap snapping shut, sharp mechanical snap with a short thud

sounds.name: tile_fate
sounds.text: Mysterious fate reveal, deep gong with a magical swell, short

sounds.name: gate_open
sounds.text: Large stone castle gate grinding open, heavy and triumphant, short

sounds.name: goal
sounds.text: Goal reached celebration, bright bell hit with a rising cheer of horns, short

sounds.name: battle_win
sounds.text: Victory stamp impact, punchy drum hit with a bright brass stab, game battle won

sounds.name: battle_lose
sounds.text: Defeat stamp impact, dull low drum hit with a falling tone, game battle lost

sounds.name: banner
sounds.text: Turn start banner slide in, quick whoosh ending in a light drum hit

sounds.name: versus
sounds.text: Versus screen clash, two heavy metallic slams and a rumbling impact, fighting game

sounds.name: double
sounds.text: Double dice bonus, two quick bright dings then a sparkle, casual game

sounds.name: card_attack
sounds.text: Magic attack card cast, sharp fiery whoosh and strike

sounds.name: card_debuff
sounds.text: Hex debuff card cast, wobbly descending magic tone

sounds.name: card_heal
sounds.text: Healing card cast, soft warm chime with a gentle shimmer

sounds.name: upgrade
sounds.text: Hero upgrade success, rising power up arpeggio ending in a bright shine

sounds.name: reward
sounds.text: Reward claimed, coins and a cheerful short ding

sounds.name: purchase
sounds.text: Shop purchase confirmed, cash register ka-ching, short

sounds.name: levelup
sounds.text: Level up jingle, short triumphant rising fanfare with sparkle, mobile game

sounds.name: summon_1
sounds.text: Card summon reveal common, soft magical pop with a light chime

sounds.name: summon_2
sounds.text: Card summon reveal rare, magical burst with bright shimmering chimes

sounds.name: summon_3
sounds.text: Card summon reveal legendary, dramatic golden burst with a choir hit and sparkling fanfare

sounds.name: roulette_tick
sounds.text: Single wheel of fortune tick, short plastic click

sounds.name: stamp
sounds.text: Rubber stamp pressed on paper, satisfying thump

sounds.name: tab
sounds.text: Soft UI tab switch, light airy tick

sounds.name: back
sounds.text: Soft UI back button, low short pop

sounds.name: popup
sounds.text: UI popup window opening, quick soft bubble swell

sounds.name: denied
sounds.text: UI error denied, two short low muted buzzes, gentle

sounds.name: aim
sounds.text: Power meter charging up, steadily rising electronic tone, short
